_comment: Regression test draft handoff for TEST-PREP: pipeline. Final instance: epics/<EPIC-KEY>/<EPIC-KEY>-tests.json. Pair with <KEY>-tests.md. Do not reference epics/<KEY>/temp/ in durable JSON. Human step norms: top-level format_norms.markdown (template only; not copied into each epic instance). Full draft prose: one subprocess per test_bundles[] row (see .cursor/pipelines/test-prep.md phase 8b). Inline example layout: docs/temp/tc-template.txt. TEST-PREP does not run Playwright/DB/SSH; optional downstream TEST-EXEC: see .cursor/pipelines/test-exec.md. automation.* hints optional; feasibility may stay unknown until TEST-EXEC or manual edit. TEST-EXEC must not run blocked bundles without explicit include_blocked=yes.

format_norms.markdown:
# Test case format (Corner QA)

Normative structure for **human-executable** regression tests drafted after epic **coverage** (Smart Checklist). Aligns with Jira **Test** issues and QAPORTAL **Test Repository** taxonomy ([Test Repository](https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/spaces/QAPORTAL/pages/497097317/Test+Repository)): internally, **compliance/coverage** is the matrix; **regression** tests are client-facing labels for E2E bundles that operationalize that matrix.

## Sections (required order)

1. **Preconditions** — numbered list; reference **Peculiarities** for setup detail (`see Peculiarities N`).
2. **Actions** — numbered list; linear user steps; reference Peculiarities when setup is non-obvious.
3. **Results** — numbered list; each item maps to the **Action** with the same index (expected observable outcome).
4. **Peculiarities** — numbered list; formulas, links (Figma, Slack, Confluence), environment notes, data setup, **copy-paste only** when sourced from Jira or an approved runbook. Use **`[TBD]`** or **`[REQUIRES: …]`** when unknown—do not invent SQL, dxCore commands, or sample outputs.

## Inline example

See repository example layout: **docs/temp/tc-template.txt** (quoted string illustrates block order and cross-references).

## Pipeline

Epic-scoped drafts: **TEST-PREP:** + Epic key → **.cursor/pipelines/test-prep.md** → `epics/<KEY>/<KEY>-tests.json` + `-tests.md`. **Source of truth for norms and schema:** this template file (**epics/templates/tests-ref.json**): top-level **format_norms.markdown**, **test_bundles[].draft**, and **_draft_note**. Instance files under `epics/<KEY>/` omit **format_norms**; inherit norms from this template + test-prep. Full **draft** text for each bundle is produced in a **separate subprocess** (one bundle per run); see test-prep playbook phases **8a** / **8b**.

taxonomy_note: Internal workflow: compliance/coverage checklist first; Jira 'regression' type is client-facing taxonomy. Draft bundles are E2E combinatoric human-executable tests that operationalize the checklist. See QAPORTAL Test Repository (page 497097317) via Confluence.

sources.note: coverage_loaded required true to run; ref_loaded/analysis_loaded optional. map_only=true: mapping + titles only, skip phase 8b subprocesses. Full drafts: one subprocess per bundle (phase 8b); durable JSON must not contain /temp/ paths.

_existing_tests_considered_item.note: reuse_recommendation set only after jira_get_issue; never invent steps from title alone

_excluded_checks_with_reason_item.evidence: pointer to coverage.explicitly_out_of_scope, checks[].ambiguity, or analysis.gaps[]

_test_bundles_item._authoring_note: subprocess_completed + completed_at set after phase 8b merge. temp_draft_file: ephemeral only during run; MUST be null in committed -tests.json—never persist paths under temp/.
_test_bundles_item._draft_note: Strings may contain [TBD] or [REQUIRES: source]. No invented dxCore/SQL/example output unless pasted from fetched Jira. Populated by per-bundle subprocess when not map_only.
_test_bundles_item._automation_note: Optional. feasibility: ui_db_only | unknown | blocked. blocked_reason when feasibility is blocked: requires_console | requires_webbroker | missing_operational_detail | other. TEST-PREP may set unknown; set blocked when draft implies console/webbroker-only setup. TEST-EXEC updates allowed only with pipeline rules.
